csv_project_name: CMAR for System-Wide Facility Renovation and Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: System-Wide Facility Renovation and Improvement Project - Springfield-Lakemore Branch and potentially other facility improvements to implement the system-wide facility renovation and improvements plan. The Akron-Summit County Public Library Board of Trustees (the Owner) intends to contract for Construction Manager at Risk (CMR) services in connection with the Springfield-Lakemore phase of the System-Wide Facility Renovation and Improvement Project (the Project) and potentially future System-Wide Facility Renovation and Improvement phases which may include one or more Phase 2 branch renovations at Mogadore, Portage Lakes and Goodyear.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management
